Now at 树林 with 4 AP. I need 6 AP to chop. My action round for this slot — can I still do anything? 4 AP left. Chopping not affordable. So wait until next slot (中午) when AP resets to 10.

Hmm, but does AP reset each slot? "每个时段你有一轮行动机会和十点行动值" — yes, 10 AP per slot.

So this morning's action is done. I'll end the turn with a narrative and maybe write memory. Let me record memory for planning: axes, wood prices, path.

Should I send any message? Not necessary. Maybe note in memory the plan.

I'll write memory and narrate.
